# SkillPrism
> Progressive Skill Disclosure & Context Compaction Engine for Autonomous AI Coding Agents

SkillPrism solves the tool-schema bloat and attention dilution problem for autonomous AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Codex, Antigravity) by indexing hundreds of MCP tool schemas out-of-context and injecting only what the model needs, right when it needs it.

Canonical Homepage: https://ritualdev.in/skillprism/
GitHub Repository: https://github.com/RitualDev-Lab/SkillPrism
IDE Extension: https://open-vsx.org/extension/ritualdev-lab/ritual-agent-defense
License: Apache-2.0

## Key Benchmarks
- Context Compression: 96.7% prompt token reduction (from 84,500 down to 2,150 tokens)
- Index Search Latency: P99 < 0.1ms BM25 local memory, < 14ms Redis VPC cluster
- Memory Footprint: < 12MB RAM for 1,000 indexed tools

## Quick Install
```bash
# Global CLI
npm install -g @ritualdev-lab/skillprism
```

## Immediate CLI Usage
```bash
# 1. Search tool index by natural developer intent
skillprism search "postgres database query"

# 2. Compact active agent conversation context into semantic surrogate receipts
skillprism compact --max-tokens 2000

# 3. Deploy Shared Team Redis VPC Cluster for multi-agent synchronization
docker compose -f docker-compose.redis-vpc.yml up -d
```

## Programmatic TypeScript / Node.js API
Use this snippet when initializing SkillPrism in an AI agent context loop:

```typescript
import { SkillPrismRegistry, JITCompactor } from "@ritualdev-lab/skillprism";

// Initialize registry with 200+ tool definitions out-of-context
const registry = new SkillPrismRegistry({
  storage: "memory", // or "redis" for enterprise VPC
  maxPromptBudgetTokens: 1500
});

// Register MCP tools
await registry.registerDirectory("./mcp-tools");

// Generate minimal initial system prompt with Zero-State Meta-Tools (< 200 tokens)
const minimalToolDefinitions = registry.getMetaTools();
// Exposes only: `search_skills(intent)` and `load_skill(skill_name)`

// Dynamically inject exact schema only when model decides to use it
const agentTurnIntent = "I need to inspect AWS S3 buckets";
const matchingTools = await registry.resolveToolsForTurn(agentTurnIntent);
console.log("Injected tools:", matchingTools.map(t => t.name));
// Injects solely `s3_list_buckets` schema, saving 96.7% of context space
```

## Core Architectural Primitives
1. **Zero-State Discovery**: Prompts initialize with minimal meta-tools (`search_skills` and `load_skill`) totaling < 200 tokens.
2. **JIT Dynamic Schema Injection**: Ephemeral injection loads exact Zod/JSON schemas only during the active turn.
3. **Semantic Query Receipts**: Heavy database rows and API return payloads are compacted into verifiable surrogate receipts.
4. **Team Shared Redis VPC Hub**: Centralizes embeddings and schemas across developer fleets running Cursor and Windsurf to eliminate duplicate indexing costs.
